strings.en: We're heading out! Uchuta! Keiko!
Wh-What's going on, Kappei?
Bandock's body, the one that got away... I found out where it is!
For real, Kappei!?
Why would I lie!?
That bastard Butcher, saying whatever he likes...!
I'll never forgive him...!
But Kappei, is it okay for us to go out alone?
If we don't go, who will!?
Keiko, it's no use. Kappei's totally lost his head.
Kappei...
I'll make him regret it...! Let's go! Zambot Combination!
...I see... As expected... the Land of Beginning...
All right, we finally caught up with Bandock from the neck down!
Mars... We chased the Gaizok all the way out here...
Bandock's body... Is the Gaizok boss inside it?
I went along with Kappei and charged out ahead, but...
Keiko, contact the Elshank!
...It's no good, we're being jammed... I can't get through.
Everyone'll catch up soon anyway.
All right, I can't wait around for them.
I'll wrap this up with just Zambot 3!
Wait a minute, Kappei!
Bandock is... giving off a huge amount of energy...!
Who cares!? I'm charging in!
Kappei, what are you so mad about!?
He says we... fight because we want somebody to thank us...?
A fight we wanted... a fight that makes somebody happy?
Screw that... Obviously it'd be better if there was no war at all.
If not for guys like him, we wouldn't be fighting in the first place...!
Who fights a war because they like it!?
People who can kill over profit and loss... I can't forgive them!
Kappei... you feel that strongly...
It's hopeless.
Keiko, there's no stopping him. ...Besides, I feel the same way.
All right... I hope everyone catches up soon...
Here we go, Gaizok! We'll bust through your gut and get inside!
Any word from the Zambot team?
Nothing so far.
I see... Captain Misumaru, how are your preparations?
All set! Clay figures, haniwa, whatever, bring 'em on!
Was it really okay to let Kappei and the others go on ahead?
Once we chose to pursue Bandock, ordering them to wait was pointless.
The way they stormed out, they'd have gone even if we said no.
The Jins as well... but Queen Sheela, Captain Bright, Commander Hazuki,
and the others who went separately... are they safe...?
They'll be fine, Princess Romina. Every one of them can be trusted.
Plenty of hotheaded meatheads among 'em, though.
That's not very convincing coming from you, Joe.
You've got it wrong, Lenny. It's convincing BECAUSE Big Bro says it.
Hahaha, Joe sure is trusted, huh?
Shut up. ...So when do we catch up with that torso bastard?
For such calculations, I'd like to rely on Miss Hoshino.
Relied upon. Zambot 3 will make contact shortly.
We're close enough that we should get ready too.
That clay-figure mothership is Bandock's main body... This is it.
If we can settle it here... we can lessen the threat to Earth.
For Earth's sake too, we can't lose!
All right, we'll reach the combat zone soon. Everyone get ready.
Captain Misumaru, the Nadesico too, battle stations.
Roger! Megumi, please let everyone know!
...Oh, I'll tell Akito myself, okay?
Hm!?
That is... no mistake, a Gaizok battleship...
Bandock, they called it? That's its body section!
Looks like we got close easy. Losing its head weaken its defenses?
Better not let our guard down... It's the Gaizok's fortress.
But there seems to be no time to think. Can you see Zambot 3?
Can't see 'em... Don't tell me they got taken out...
No! Kappei and the others wouldn't go down that easily...
Wait, there's a hole in the side of Bandock.
A hole? Could it be... Zambot is inside there...?
They went in on their own? Geez, they've done it now...
Well, everyone, what the Gaizok boss looks like...
let's see it with our own eyes!
(Kappei... don't be rash...)
